title: Onprem upgrade state divergence: snapshot + staged restore runbook and operator preflight fixes
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Summary:
A recent on-prem customer upgrade from operator v2.11 -> v2.14 failed during Helm release apply for several tenants. Symptoms include HelmDeploy stuck in 'progressing', reconciler loops with repeated CR update events, and operator-side finalizer removal leading to stale tenant state. Multiple customers escalated (priority P0) due to downtime for model-serving endpoints and inability to run scheduled inference jobs.

What we observed:
- Helm reports: 'Waiting for resource post-upgrade', hooks hanging on pre/post-release hooks for node-agent and kv-rotation jobs.
- Operator logs: reconcile loops with 409 conflicts and transient manifest checksum mismatches.
- KV data: schema version skew across replicas (kvcache schema 3 vs expected 4) causing controller-side migrations to fail with panic in migration worker.
- Some ConfigMaps/Secrets were silently dropped during helm value merge due to an edge-case in our templating layer that removes empty map keys.

Immediate mitigation performed:
- Rolled back Helm release for 3 affected tenants and re-created a targeted operator pod with env DEBUG=true to capture extended logs.
- Applied an emergency snapshot (s3/onprem NFS) of the tenant kvcache and pushed to customer-side staging.
- Enabled a temporary routing policy that sends traffic to Dedicated fallback pool for critical tenants.

Root cause hypothesis (current):
1) Helm templating/values merge produced an empty opaque ConfigMap in some upgrade paths; downstream controller assumed presence of that key and ran a partial migration that touched KV schemas.
2) Operator migration worker is not idempotent for interrupted runs (no safe checkpointing), so retries produced divergent schema versions across nodes.
3) Helm post-upgrade hooks that assert manifest parity can hang if operator is mid-migration, producing the observed Helm 'progressing' state and blocking complete upgrades.
plan:
Technical tasks:
1) migration-checkpointing: add status.checkpoints array + idempotent resume logic (Ravi) - 2d
2) helm-preflight-probe: patch chart + helm test hook (SRE) - 1d
3) snapshot-operator: implement kvcache snapshot API and uploader (Aisha) - 3d
4) staged-restore-tool: CLI to validate and apply snapshot to staging tenant (2d)
5) e2e canary pipeline: integrate into infra CI (1d)
6) docs+runbook: confluence page and KB (1d)
